author: Janelle Tucker
title: Severe Weather Threat Increases for Thursday - NewsBreak
text:
By Janelle Tucker ,
16 hours ago The threat for severe weather has increased for Thursday. The National Weather Service says there is an Enhanced (Level 3 out of 5) Risk for severe storms for much of the KMCH listening area, including Delaware, Dubuque, Jones, Linn and southern Buchanan counties. There is a Slight (Level 2 out of 5) Risk for severe storms for the rest of the listening area, including northern Buchanan, Fayette and Clayton counties. All hazards possible, including tornadoes, damaging winds up to 70 miles per hour and half-dollar sized hail. Read full article
